entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NullReferenceException in `IncludeJsonEntityCollection` with `UseLazyLoadingProxies()` + `OwnsMany().ToJson()` containing a primitive collection (works without proxies) #38466
    11.0.0

Closed

  • The `Complex` property does not work with raw SQL #38461
  • dbcontext optimize --nativeaot produces CS1503 #38465
  • ComplexProperty ToJson(): SaveChangesAsync throws 'ordinal -1 is invalid' when nested sub-collection grows (2+ JSON columns) #38299
    10.0.10
  • Nullable navigation properties lead to unexpected outer join criteria #35706
    11.0.0
  • Various model building issues #22414
    11.0.0
  • DbContext.Entry().Reference().Load() falsely tracks existing reference entity as Added #35762
    11.0.0
  • Migration generation fails for SqlVector<float> #37231
    11.0.0
  • Conflicting partition key filter is ignored in ReadItem case #38238
    11.0.0
  • Allow FKs to have a different type from PKs in the snapshot #30827
    11.0.0
  • Package 'SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3' 2.1.11 has a known high severity vulnerability #38467
  • Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite reference vulnerable/deprecated package #38463

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix NullReferenceException materializing JSON owned collections with nested primitive collections under lazy-loading proxies #38473
  • Fix alter column type JSON to nVarchar #38464
    community-contribution
  • Fix XML parameter encoding for SQL Server #38462

Merged

  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26312.108 to 11.0.0-beta.26319.1 #38470
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38435
  • Keep nullable outer-key null check in compound APPLY→JOIN predicates #38449
  • Fix inverting identifying FK using wrong type and short-circuit principal type on attach #38423
  • Bump System.CommandLine from 2.0.5 to 2.0.9 #38472
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.15.1 to 1.16.0 #38471
    area-infrastructure
  • Mark entities as unchanged when matched by entities loaded from database #38452
  • Validate unsupported options on full-text and vector indexes #38447
  • Bump actions/checkout from 6.0.3 to 7.0.0 #38468
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump dotnet/arcade/.github/workflows/inter-branch-merge-base.yml from a6bacc00545c78b35c459f81331508e43d835d23 to 69bac0b76e58dc33ee3ee9740b6ae5b3e4c3b65a #38469
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix migration generation for non-nullable SqlVector columns #38451
    api-review
  • Don't transform Cosmos query to ReadItem when WithPartitionKey conflicts with predicate partition key #38439
  • Make model snapshots with mismatched FK/PK property types usable #38450
  • Throw for multiple owned entities set to the same instance #38446
    api-review
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38453

Updated

  • Unskip tests that aren't failing anymore #38474
  • Make type mapping generic so that it can create value comparers for NativeAOT #38440
    providers-beware
  • Fix precompiled query generation for shadow property names that are not valid identifiers #38458
  • Lift try..catch out of an expression and replace with a temporary variable #34912
    community-contribution
  • Implement SQLite TimeSpan translation #37804
    community-contribution
  • Handle JSON null token when reading collections mapped to JSON #38459
